name: GlobalFoundries Inc.
blurb: GlobalFoundries Inc. (NASDAQ: GFS) is the world's third-largest semiconductor foundry by revenue, operating advanced manufacturing facilities in the United States (Fab 8 in Malta, NY; Vermont), Germany (Dresden), and Singapore. Unlike TSMC and Samsung, GlobalFoundries exited the leading-edge node race in 2018 and now focuses on differentiated specialty processes: silicon photonics, silicon-germanium (SiGe), RF CMOS, FD-SOI (fully depleted silicon-on-insulator), and embedded non-volatile memory. This positions GF as a complement — and sometimes a competitor — to Tower Semiconductor in the specialty foundry space.
recent: GF reported FY2025 revenue of $6.79 billion (up 1% year-over-year) with gross margin improving 360 basis points to 29% and diluted EPS of $1.72. Silicon photonics revenue exceeded $200 million in 2025 and is expected to nearly double in 2026, with management guiding toward a $1 billion annual run rate by end-2028. In June 2025, the company announced a $16 billion US investment plan anchored by its New York and Vermont fabs. GF also finalised a $1.5 billion CHIPS Act direct-funding agreement with the US government. In January 2026, GF agreed to acquire Synopsys' ARC Processor IP unit, targeting physical-AI embedded applications.

sources.title: GlobalFoundries Reports Strong Q4 and FY2025 Results — Power Semiconductors Weekly
